Field benchmark of causal-discovery methods across scenarios

Source: R/data.R
cd_field_benchmark.Rd

A summary of sixteen established causal-discovery methods run across the nine structural-causal-model scenarios of cd_scenarios(), each method scored against the scenario's known DAG and averaged over random-graph seeds. It is the evidence that grounds the routing preferences in cd_auto(), and the worked example in the package vignette.

Usage

cd_field_benchmark

Format

A data frame with 143 rows and 11 columns:

scenario

Scenario name (see cd_scenarios()).

scenario_family

The scenario's structural-causal-model family.

method

Method id (see list_methods()).

method_name

Human-readable method name.

family

Algorithm family.

shd

Mean structural Hamming distance to the true DAG (lower is better).

shd_sd

Standard deviation of the structural Hamming distance across seeds.

skeleton_f1

Mean skeleton (adjacency) F1 (higher is better).

orient_recall

Mean orientation recall.

runtime_s

Mean wall-clock runtime in seconds.

n_seed

Number of random-graph seeds averaged.

Details

One row per (scenario, method). The kernel conditional-independence method (pc_kci_cl) was not run on the ten-variable scenario, so that one (scenario, method) cell is absent, giving 143 rows.

See also

cd_benchmark(), cd_auto(), cd_scenarios()

Examples

# overall ranking by mean structural Hamming distance across scenarios
agg <- aggregate(shd ~ method_name, data = cd_field_benchmark, FUN = mean)
agg[order(agg$shd), ]
